name: Branch Drift
office_task: Every week, check each branch or franchise against our written operating standard, score its drift the same way for all, send each its own report, and put a slipping one in front of a named person.
systems_of_record: the versioned key contract the business keeps (a SharePoint list or Google Sheet) that issues the contract version
Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace access groups, which decide which branch a record belongs to
each branch's own report location (a folder, channel or list) that issues the report_id
the exception desk the business runs, which issues the exception_id

emits.write: one drift report per branch, published on schedule whether or not anything drifted, into that branch's own report location with the centre's copy at the same detail: each finding's kind (schema, gate bypass, shadow register, silence), the record it points to, the contract version it was scored against and the one score
emits.readback: the report location returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the branch's segment_id, the period, the contract version and the findings list (empty on an all-clear); no id back means the report was not published and an exception is raised

emits.write: an exception naming one person: a branch past its threshold routed to its named owner, a branch owned only by a distribution list, a refused rename or second key that asks for a contract version bump, a record refused because a new branch's gates are not yet live, or a contract that could not be read as a versioned document
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the segment_id, the reason and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
